sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Punisher - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hey there, man. Well, my friends are clearly up to something. Last time you dropped some Scavs, they called me almost instantly, and, you know, it seemed like they had a bit of entertainment going on. Making bets, making cash. Long story short, they want you to decimate Scavs again, but this time on Customs and using a good old AKS-74U. I don't really want to know what kind of show they are making of it, but they offer some top cash. So, you in?"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 25 Scavs with AKS-74U on Customs

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- 165,000 Roubles
  - 173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× Lobaev Arms DVL-10 7.62x51 bolt-action sniper rifle (variant Urbana)
- Unlocks craft for 5.45x39mm PP gs at Workbench level 2
"Look at you, a Punisher if I ever saw one! There's a rumor going about that some monster is dropping the scum in big numbers. My cronies send you their regards and some splendid presents."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
In this quest you have to kill 25 Scavs on Customs with short AK series assault rifles. You can use any of the following:
- AKS-74U
- AKS-74UN
- AKS-74UB
- SAG AK Short
